primary_claims: crossfit KAHM vs full-A common plus shared bias, nonlinear,3%
crossfit KAHM vs independently selected crossfit RBF, nonlinear,3%
crossfit KAHM vs expanded non-KAHM policy, nonlinear,3%
analysis.secondary_intervals: Descriptive unadjusted95% paired t, not simultaneous

computational_reproduction.chronology_interpretation: This reproduction follows knowledge of earlier reported results and is not a new prospective preregistration. New source and phase seals precede regenerated data and scoring only within this reproduction.
computational_reproduction.historical_output_scope: Prior assistant reports of aggregate performance and audit failure were known before this reproduction; their underlying completed-run records were not recovered.

original_numerical_amendment.cohort: Same 192 tasks, exact original ABC bytes, same reserved D streams; all fits restarted
original_numerical_amendment.solver_rule: Original centered ridge path first; only LinAlgError triggers finite-matrix SciPy gesvd fallback
original_numerical_amendment.timing: After original ABC preparation and aborted fitting, before any D generation
original_numerical_amendment.unchanged: Objective, alpha grid, candidate grids, all selection rules, inferential claims, margins, and D seeds

computational_reproduction.phase_gate_scope: New source freeze before regeneration; seal all new fits before D generation; seal all new forecasts before target release and unchanged analysis. These gates describe only the reproduction execution.
computational_reproduction.regeneration_scope: Regenerate A/B/C and D from the exact declared master seed and component streams; recompute all 192 fits; do not assert byte identity to unavailable original arrays or execution records.
computational_reproduction.reproduction_publication_commit_recordin: The actual reproduction source-publication commit is recorded separately after freeze and publication; it cannot self-bind in the frozen source. source.publication_commit remains the unchanged historical lineage field.
computational_reproduction.result_interpretation: Computational reproduction on the same declared simulation cohort, not a fresh independent confirmation, not additional repetitions, and not retrospective authentication of the original execution.
computational_reproduction.solver_scope: Byte-identical numerical_solver installed unconditionally by byte-identical worker_fit; only unavailable historical exact-byte reuse metadata is removed.

crossfit.common_selection: Each complement fit independently selects scaler, native cap and penalties on B; complement-only target-variance normalizer
crossfit.departure_history_geometry: All retained A inputs, reused identically across target modes
crossfit.fold_fit_seed: Same task fit seed across full, fold and half fits; no new random seed needed
crossfit.full_common: Separate full-A gamma-one B-selected common from verified PrimarySuite
crossfit.half_common: First32 original A episodes, independently B selected common only; no half-split correction claim
crossfit.response_intercept: Omitted; predict only centered feature slopes
crossfit.shared_bias: mean_B(Y_B - full_A_common_B), fixed across all correction methods

seed_derivation.additional_exclusion_check: All inherited prior exclusions plus complete preprocessing-study stream roster
seed_derivation.collision_policy: Stop before generation if any intended-distinct derived seed collides
seed_derivation.pairing: No history, noise level or candidate cap in generation, unit-noise, retained-row or fit streams

selection.C: Correction eta per horizon and one expanded policy family across horizons; no common/cap/scaler/alpha refit
selection.D: Prediction only after full fit seal, scoring only after full prediction seal
selection.common: B, per-horizon ridge penalties then one cap/scaler across horizons; cap-first then scaler order
selection.common_bias: B residual mean only; no C bias selection
selection.departure: B, independently per target mode and kind, per-horizon alpha then one cap/scaler across horizons
selection.matched_RBF: RBF at same target-mode KAHM selected scaler and cap, own B alpha and C eta

study_id: Honest cross-fitted residual corrections with a full-training common predictor
